get.description:
The Unified Market API returns the cumulative information for a specified bond for a given risk group.

If the specified bond exists in our universe, you will receive a response with the full order book, the evaluated price, yield-to-worst and yield-to-maturity, a yield grid, the accrued interest and par value, and the total fees for the instrument.

If the specified bond does not exist in our universe or is inactive, you will receive a `not_found` error.

parameters.name: risk_group_id
parameters.description: The risk group ID to use for this quote. A risk group is required for fees and yields to be accurately reflected in the return.

parameters.name: skip_fees
parameters.description: Do not include fees in the response.

evaluated_price.description: The evaluated price of the bond

evaluated_yield_to_maturity.description: The evaluated yield to maturity of the bond

evaluated_yield_to_worst.description: The evaluated yield to worst of the bond

accrued_interest.description: The accrued interest of the bond

par_value.description: The par value of the bond

receipient_id.description: The ID of the fee owner

price.description: Prices, represented as a percentage of par.

yield_to_maturity.description: Yield to maturity for each price.

yield_to_worst.description: Yield to worst for each price, when available.

min_balance_remaining.description: The minimum amount in par that must remain on the quote after a partial fill. If an incoming order would reduce the remaining balance below this minimum, the entire remaining balance is filled instead.

min_increment.description: The minimum quantity increment for which orders can be placed on this quote. All orders executing on this quote must be in multiples of this value.

min_size.description: Ask minimum trade size in par value

spread_to_benchmark_bps.description: Spread to benchmark in basis points

get.description:
The Full Order Book API returns the current full order book for a specified bond.

If the specified bond exists in our universe, you will receive a
response with all bids and asks in the order book. Moment
will provide data on yields to maturity and yields to worst as
available, however, Moment can not guarantee that these yields will be
available for all bonds. If yields are not available, the response will
contain null values for yield-related fields.

If the specified bond does not exist in our universe or is inactive, you
will receive a `not_found` error. If the bond is not tradeable, you will
receive a `bad_request` error.

parameters.name: risk_group_id
parameters.description: The risk group ID to use for this quote. A risk group is required for fees and yields to be accurately reflected in the return. If a risk group is not provided, your organization's default risk group will be used. If a risk group is not provided and your organization has no default risk group, the request will fail.

parameters.description: Do not include fees in the response.

get.description:
The Top of Order Book API returns the current best bid and offer for a specified bond.

If the specified bond exists in our universe, you will receive a response with all available data regarding the best bid and best ask. For example, if there are only asks and no bids for a given bond, the response will contain data for the ask-related fields, while the bid-related fields will all be null. If there are neither bids nor asks, the response will contain null values for all ask and bid fields.
Moment will provide data on yields to maturity and yields to worst as available, however, Moment can not guarantee that these yields will be available for all bonds. If yields are not available, the response will contain null values for yield-related fields.

If the specified bond does not exist in our universe or is inactive, you will receive a `not_found` error. If the bond is not tradeable, you will receive a `bad_request` error.

parameters.name: risk_group_id
parameters.description: The risk group ID to use for this quote. A risk group is required for fees and yields to be accurately reflected in the return. If a risk group is not provided, your organization's default risk group will be used. If a risk group is not provided and your organization has no default risk group, the request will fail.

parameters.name: trade_size
parameters.description:
Trade size for the quote. Filters to best bid/ask where minimum trade size is less than or equal to the given numeric value. Optionally, set value to "lowest" for best bid/ask for the smallest trade size on either side.

For example, assume bids {bid_price: 100, bid_min_size: 5000}, {bid_price: 99, bid_min_size: 2000}, and {bid_price: 98, bid_min_size: 1000} are available. Querying with trade_size=3000 returns the {bid_price: 99, bid_min_size: 2000} bid. Querying with trade_size="lowest" returns the {bid_price: 98, bid_min_size:1000} bid."

parameters.name: skip_fees
parameters.description: Do not include fees in the response.

timestamp.description: Timestamp in RFC-3339 format with nanosecond precision

bid_size.description: Best bid size in par value

bid_min_size.description: Best bid minimum trade size in par value

bid_min_balance_remaining.description: The minimum amount in par that must remain on the bid after a partial fill. If an incoming order would reduce the remaining balance below this minimum, the entire remaining balance is filled instead.

bid_min_increment.description: The minimum quantity increment for which orders can be placed on this bid. All orders executing on this bid must be in multiples of this value.

ask_size.description: Best ask size in par value

ask_min_size.description: Best ask minimum trade size in par value

ask_min_balance_remaining.description: The minimum amount in par that must remain on the ask after a partial fill. If an incoming order would reduce the remaining balance below this minimum, the entire remaining balance is filled instead.

ask_min_increment.description: The minimum quantity increment for which orders can be placed on this ask. All orders executing on this ask must be in multiples of this value.

get.description:
The Trade Price API returns the principal, the accrued interest,
the total fees (as a result of the risk group), and the total trade costs
for a specified instrument, trade size, price, and risk group.

If the specified bond does not exist in our universe, you
will receive a `not_found` error.

parameters.name: trade_size
parameters.description: The trade size of an order in face value. For example, most corporate bonds have a face value of $1000, so a trade_size of $3000 indicates a trade for 3 bonds.

parameters.name: price
parameters.description: The price is represented as a percentage of par. For a typical $1,000 par value bond, a price of $90 values the bond at $900.

parameters.name: risk_group_id
parameters.description: The risk group ID to use for this quote. A risk group is required for fees to be accurately reflected in the return.

principal.description: The principal amount of the trade, specified in the issuing currency.

accrued_interest.description: The cumulative amount of accrued interest for the trade, specified in the issuing currency.

total_fees.description: The total fees for the trade, specified in the issuing currency.

get.description: The Trading Calendar API returns a list of days in sequential order, with information regarding whether that day is a full trading day, half trading day, holiday, or weekend. Currently, Moment only supports dates between 2023-08-01 and 2026-01-01 (inclusive).

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: The start date of the calendar formatted as yyyy-mm-dd.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: The end date of the calendar formatted as yyyy-mm-dd.

days.description: A list containing information about each day between the start_date and end_date.
